page.overview:
What is Azalea Town?

Azalea Town (ヒワダタウン Hiwada Town) is a location introduced in Generation II.

Azalea Town is a small, isolated town located on the southern peninsula of the Johto region. Azalea Town has fewer buildings than other towns in the region, but it has many trees which make it rich in Bug Type Pokémon. Azalea Town has a Pokémon Center and a Poké Mart, like with other towns. It has a Pokémon Gym named Azalea Town Gym, which is run by Bugsy, who specializes in -type Pokémon.

It contains two houses. One of them is owned by a Woodcutter who gives the players HM Cut after they complete a mini quest. The other house is Kurt's House, where Kurt makes Poké Balls from Apricorns. Azalea Town is where Slowpoke Well can be accessed.

Azalea Town is where Team Rocket is encountered for the first time. The player's rival also appears at the gate to Ilex Forest, and a battle with him is required to pass through. Azalea Town is also the only place at which Charcoal can be purchased.
